formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: src/domain/performance/lookBack.ts:97-110 — amount × factor, change, (factor − 1) × 100, difference = moved − stayed. The factor comes from the series it is handed, and the app's one feed hands dividend-adjusted closes (src/services/marketData.ts:59-64, Yahoo adjclose; raw close only when adjclose is absent).
governing_decisions: DEC-0595 (its "market figure is price only" wording is stale for the same reason)
formula_checks.plain_example: $10,000 in a bond fund $72.00 → $72.50 that paid $3.10 a share. The card and the screen note say price only ($10,069); the app, fed adjusted closes, gives $10,500 — the right total-return figure. The card and the note should say distributions are included.

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: src/domain/performance/lookBack.ts:56 — cutoff = new Date(year, month − months, day), which rolls a missing day into the next month.
governing_decisions: DEC-3768b (its governs list names MK-PF-F-008 and MK-NW-F-090; its words cover any whole-month window)
formula_checks.plain_example: Today 31 Mar, one month back. Before: measured from 3 March ($53 → $55, ×1.0377). Should be: from 28 Feb, last close 27 Feb ($50 → $55, ×1.10). The look-back screen offers 12/24/36 months, so a 29 Feb today is where it shows.

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: src/domain/performance/index.ts:584 — the close of the last item in the list. The one feed builds its list oldest first (src/services/marketData.ts:66-71).
formula_checks.plain_example: A newest-first list (9, 8, 7 Oct) would give 7 Oct's $212.66 instead of $213.47; no feed of the app sends that order today. The card should state that every price list is oldest first.

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: src/domain/performance/index.ts:626 — start = closeAsOf(the period's first day), i.e. that day's own close; :506 falls back to the first close on record; :642 counts years as days ÷ 365.25 (MK-NW-O-008 uses ÷ 365).
formula_checks.plain_example: $100 on 9 Sep, $102 on 10 Sep, $110 on 9 Oct, 1M from 10 Sep. Before: +7.84%. Should be: +10.00% (from the close of the day before). The fallback (a 1Y figure for a five-month-old fund reads +3.40%) and the 365.25 day count are NEEDS RULING.

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: src/domain/performance/index.ts:680 → :506 — when no close is on or before the date, the first close on record is used.
formula_checks.plain_example: Bought 5 Jan; prices start 2 Mar at $25.00; $25.85 now. Before: "+3.40% since you bought it". Ruling needed: refuse, or say "since 2 March".

formula_checks.what_the_code_actually_does: src/domain/performance/index.ts:500-506 — last close on or before the target; when every close is later, the first close on record ("target predates the series → first available", written on purpose). closeOnOrBefore (:545) is its no-fallback twin.
formula_checks.plain_example: Asked for 10 Oct 2025; the fund's first close is 2 Mar 2026 at $25.00. Before: $25.00. Ruling needed: nothing (as MK-PF-F-034), or the first price with its date said.
